description:
Unified candidate management for the ATS pipeline. Actions:
CRUD: add, update, delete, move, bulk_move, list
Analytics: rank (sort by fit), filter (by criteria), recommend_stage (suggest moves), compare (side-by-side), summarize (overview stats)
Pass the current candidates record and an action. Returns updated state and/or analysis results.

candidates.description: Current candidates record (id → candidate object). Pass {} for a fresh start. For analytics actions (rank/filter/compare/summarize/recommend_stage), pass as array or record.

criteria.description: For rank/filter: { requiredSkills?: string[], minimumRating?: number, stages?: string[], tags?: string[], sortBy?: 'rating'|'name'|'stage'|'assessment', limit?: number }

jobDescription.description: Optional job description for relevance ranking (used by 'rank' action).

name: ats_manage_candidates
